name: Worktree Collection
description: Shows a conversation's worktree collection: its repositories with pending changes, pull requests with CI, and running services, in a panel and a card above the message box.

teamTailnet.description: The gateway's tailnet is the team's, not a person's: offer Tailscale tunnels to services, which everyone on it can reach.

harnesses.description: This gateway's wtc projects: each a harness repository whose .harness-repos.yml lists the project's repositories. A collection works in one: its first wtc add-repo adds a worktree of the harness, and repository names resolve through its registry. None configured: every collection is ad hoc.

name.description: The wtc project's name, as wtc add-repo --project takes it.

remote.description: The harness repository on GitHub or Bitbucket, as an HTTPS or git@ URL. The gateway must have it as a project.

ref.description: Branch new worktrees of the harness start from.

pullRequestEvents.description: How a collection's conversation hears that a pull request of it was opened, merged or closed, became ready, failed or passed its checks, was approved, got a request for changes or conflicts with its base: wake gives it a turn now, queue tells it on its next turn, off says nothing.

pullRequestPollMinutes.description: How often collections with an open pull request are looked at while nobody has their card open. 0 looks only when a card does.

defaultHarness.description: The default wtc project: chooses between projects whose registries list the repositories a new collection adds, and stands in when none lists them (as the only configured project does). A project that lists them beats it; a repository the chosen project does not list is asked about.

sandboxGit.description: Serve the gateway's clones to sandboxed sessions, read-only, and take back their branches with wtc catch-up. The sandboxes reach it on a Docker network they share with the gateway, at the address set as WTC_GATEWAY_GIT in their environment. It answers sandbox containers of this gateway only.

host.description: The address to listen on: the gateway's address on the sandboxes' network, or all.
